name: Gloves of Paired Weapons
body:
Price 500 GP (+1), 2,000 GP (+2), 4,500 GP (+3), 8,000 GP (+4), 12,500 GP (+5); Slot hands; CL 6th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

These sleek fingerless gloves seem to glow with power when the wearer holds two weapons, causing both weapons to faintly glow with power. When wielding two weapons, as long as at least 1 of them has a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls, both wielded weapons benefit from this enhancement bonus. The wearer can designate their unarmed strikes as a second weapon for this effect as long as they are only wielding one weapon. Gloves that can transfer larger enhancement bonuses can be found, although they are far more rare.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 250 GP (+1), 1,000 GP (+2), 2,250 GP (+3), 4,000 GP (+4), 6,250 GP (+5); Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells magic weapon
